title: user.password_reset (v1)
description: A user completed a self-service password reset. Emitted when a user completes the self-service password reset flow (the reset proof is consumed and the password replaced). All sessions and grants are revoked (session.revoked with reason "password_reset"); MFA requirements are unchanged. Ordinary password changes and administrator actions do not emit this event. org_id is never set.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

user_id.description: The user whose password was reset.

org_id.description: Never set for this event type by the current server.
